title: Decoded Issue #7 promo: build a test calendar, not a content calendar
hook: Decoded Issue #7 is out: 2027 creative planning. Build a test calendar, not a content calendar.
caption:
Decoded Issue #7 is out: 2027 creative planning. Build a test calendar, not a content calendar.

A content calendar tells you what to post on which date. A test calendar tells you what you’re trying to learn, and by when.

In this issue: how to turn next year’s launches, sales and festivals into a sequence of questions your ads can answer, so January’s creative teaches February’s.

If you’re planning Q1 this week, this one is for you.
